Animated Grease Pencil -> Mesh Conversion

Using `scene.blend`, create three mesh objects named `Frame_1_Mesh`, `Frame_10_Mesh`, and `Frame_20_Mesh`, then save `answer.blend`. Their mesh data must have exactly `8 verts \ 7 edges`, `12 verts \ 11 edges`, and `16 verts \ 15 edges` respectively. Each object must have a `hide_viewport` f-curve with at least one keyframe. At frame `1`, only `Frame_1_Mesh` may be visible; at frame `10`, only `Frame_10_Mesh`; at frame `20`, only `Frame_20_Mesh`. The original `Sketch` object may remain or be removed.
source: Blender Manual — Convert Grease Pencil to Mesh
